reviews.title: Huge Cinebench Performance Upgrade
reviews.comment:
Had an cooler with bad pump and replaced it with this one. All the items of the installation was provided, including SATA power split, all screws and thermal paste. My previous idle temps of 60C went down to the 30s, improved my Cinebench performance from 1500pts to 4800pts. I'm very pleased with my purchase.
Make sure you have a USB connector available on your motherboard to customize the display.
reviews.author: Kunal

reviews.title: Just buy it already
reviews.comment: The media could not be loaded.  https://m.media-amazon.com/images/I/D1tkivmj30L.mp4 https://m.media-amazon.com/images/I/61F05avQckL._SY256.jpg WOW. What an amazing cooler. Keeps my Intel 270K Plus very cool, even under load. It looks amazing and the removable, magnetic pump cover is great. Would highly recommend
reviews.author: Brandon Church

reviews.title: It is very nice, i think its worth it.
reviews.comment: I bought the fanless version and i love that its an option. The value for it is fair in my opinion, as the cooling for it is actually pretty cold while gaming i have it at 44 in my motherboard and the block itself saying 55. Note! I have my cpu undervolted, and i am running a Ryzen 7 9800x3d. The noise is non-existent. The fitting a bit of an issue i just wished they would add just a couple more centimeters like 5 to 6 and it wouldve been perfect fit for me. As it gives it
reviews.author: Ruben Melendez

reviews.title: 5 Big Booms
reviews.comment: Love it, would recommend the Arctic Freeze 3 pro for better cooling. Yet this does what it needs to run high-stress workspaces and games, while looking dope.
reviews.author: Alec L.

reviews.title: Great cooler with kinda janky software
reviews.comment: It works great and was easy to install. My complaint is the software. It’s super finicky. Sometimes it detects the usb header and sometimes it doesn’t. I tried plugging in the controller to the usb port on back of motherboard and that works much better. Still annoying that it must load up into windows and run the LConnect software before it remembers the “advanced” LCD settings which I am just using a preloaded option.
reviews.author: Shawn Ryan
